notes: ACCESS: direct fetch, no proxy needed (matches the prior Home-Decor pass on this SR). Next.js SSR storefront. TREE: taken from the live /ae/en mega-menu parsed off the rendered HTML (Menu_menuLevelListInner blocks), which gives 12 Furniture groups (Sofas, Living Room, Bedroom Furniture, Mattresses, Modular, Wardrobes, Bedroom Storage, Dining, Seating, Kids & Teens, Office Furniture, Game Room Furniture) plus Outdoor > Outdoor Sets and Bath > Vanity; cross-checked against /ae/en/sitemap/category_sitemap_ae_en.xml (1,533 category URLs; 274 under /c/furniture/, 108 under /c/outdoor/). DEPTH: each PLP also renders its own child-category strip (Plp_plpTopCategoryContainer). I recursed through it, but it is a mix of real subcategory paths and literal filter query strings (?ft_table_shape=, ?ft_table_functionality=, ?ft_table_type=, ?ft_family=), which are excluded per the brief. Rule applied: a mega-menu node is recorded as a leaf unless its PLP exposes path-based children that are genuinely different PRODUCT TYPES; where the children are only size/seater/door/capacity/shape/material refinements of the same product they were treated as filters and the parent kept as the leaf. So Cabinets & Sideboards -> Kitchen Cabinets/Buffet Tables/Bar Tables, Chairs -> Indoor Chairs -> Armchair/Accent/Wing/Swivel/Lounge/Folding/Rocking plus Indoor Benches, Office Desks -> Study/Height-Adjustable/Meeting/Reception/Workstation, Kids Beds/Accessories/Study Furniture, and Vanity -> Single/Double/Triple Basin were expanded; while Corner Sofas (seater), Recliners (seater), Swing Door Wardrobes (door count), Shoe Cabinets (pairs), Dining Table Set (seater), Fabric Beds (bed size), Outdoor Sofa/Dining Sets and Swings (seater), TV & Media Units (5 mount/storage configs whose counts sum to 648 > the parent's 419, i.e. overlapping facets), Ottomans & Poufs (fabric/velvet/folding = material-mechanism facets) and Office Chairs (high/mid/low back = same product, different back height) were kept as leaves. QTY: every PLP renders 'N Results for "<Category>"' and the same integer is server-embedded at __NEXT_DATA__:props.pageProps.totalProductsFromServer. Verified equal on all 87 leaves. Independently proved exact by full enumeration on Dining Chairs: totalPages=5, pages 1-5 yield 48+48+48+48+35 = 227 unique product ids = the reported 227, and page 6 returns 0 tiles. Also enumerated 5 single-page categories (Modular Sofas 24, Modular Wardrobes 22, Stools 48, Serving Trolleys 9, Day Bed 2) where unique product ids == the reported total. SANITY: every leaf was re-fetched a second time - zero drift on all 87; the h1 of each page matches the category requested (no silent parent-serving); counts differ per category (the /c/furniture root itself returns exactly 10,000, a display cap, but it is only ever a grouping row here so no capped number is emitted). Modular Sofas and Modular Wardrobes are the only two leaves whose template renders no count header - qty there is from __NEXT_DATA__ and was confirmed by enumeration; both flagged. EXCLUDED and why: Mattresses (whole group, incl. all size/feel/type nodes) - bedding, not furniture; Outdoor Umbrella (30) and Gazebo/Pergola (18/1) - shade structures, not furniture; Massage Accessories (2, massage machines); Soft Toys (8); the Organiser parent (143) and its child Cabinets Boxes & Organizers (33) and Toy Storage (90) - plastic modular organisers, drawer organisers, storage bags and rolling carts, i.e. standalone storage goods (only its Room Divider child, 14, is furniture and is emitted under Living Room); bath fixtures (wash basins, water closets, mixers, showers, tubs) and bath/mirrors-cabinets/mirror-cabinet (33, mirror-fronted, mixed with plain mirrors); the Furnishings, Lighting, Home Decor, Kitchen, Tiles, DIY and Electronics departments; Garden Accessories > camping-chairs/camping-table (portable camping gear); and 'All Beds' (/bedroom-furniture/beds, 5,915) as a section-3 'All ...' node. NOT-IN-NAV ROLL-UPS DELIBERATELY DROPPED: /c/furniture/tables (1,379), /c/furniture/showcase (295), /c/furniture/furniture-storage (919), /c/furniture/foldable-table (102), /c/furniture/single-chair (580), /c/furniture/office-furniture/home-office (72), /c/furniture/seating/chairs-stools/stools (148), /c/book-shelves (10), /c/storage-units (138), /c/outdoor/modular-outdoor-sofas (1). These are real PLPs in the sitemap but are unreachable from the site's navigation and are cross-cutting roll-ups that would double-count the nav tree. DUPLICATE SLUGS RESOLVED to the nav URL: /seating/chairs (332) == /seating/cafe-chairs (332); /outdoor-sets/sun-loungers (20) == /outdoor-sets/loungers (20); /outdoor-sets/balcony-table-and-chairs-set (66) == /outdoor-sets/balcony-sets (66); /furniture/sofas/modular-sofas (24) == /furniture/modular/modular-sofas (24). OVERLAP TO BE AWARE OF (all are the site's own sibling nodes, so all are kept): Fabric Beds re-slices the same bed catalogue as the four bed-size nodes; Kids & Teens Beds (2,157) and the bedroom Single Beds node (2,152) are effectively the same marketplace single-bed catalogue seen from two departments; 4+ Seater Sofas (470) is the union of the 4/5/7-seater chip pages (317+121+33). REMAINDER: several parents hold items no child covers - e.g. the Living Room parent reports 1,740 against its 10 children, Seating 918 against Chairs 332, Office Furniture 1,691. Those parents are emitted as grouping rows per the brief, so those extra items are not counted anywhere.
